ns2:course.label: Cell & Membrane Physiology
ns2:course.description: Foundational principles of cellular physiology. Topics include solute/water transport, membrane bio electricity, action potentials, ion channel physiology, neuromuscular transmission, muscle physiology, and central neurophysiology and plasticity. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MCB 252 or consent of instructor.
